The Art of Connection

LUCIEN is a private members society built around curated events, intimate retreats, meaningful relationships, and elevated hospitality.

Membership is intentionally limited and reviewed privately.

What LUCIEN Is
A Private Membership
A reviewed society of ambitious, curious people across industries and cities.
A Social Calendar
Member gatherings, salons, cultural moments, and hospitality-led experiences throughout the year.
A Trusted Network
A curated directory and warm introductions designed for meaningful connection.
A Hospitality Layer
Concierge support, member benefits, and select retreats designed to expand your world.
Why LUCIEN Exists
The world has never been more connected. Meaningful connection has rarely been harder to find.

LUCIEN creates rooms where ambitious, curious people can meet through hospitality instead of performance.

The point is simple: better people, better conversations, better access to the world around you.

Events & Retreats
Examples of the world LUCIEN is building.
The Founder’s Invitational
An example member gathering: a luxury golf experience overlooking the Pacific, centered on hospitality and conversation.
Midnight Masquerade
An example evening: cinematic black-tie, old-world glamour, mystery, and culture.
Retreats
LUCIEN intends to host a limited number of intimate retreats for deeper connection.
Maui House
A private oceanfront wellness retreat centered around restoration, reflection, and connection.
Winter House
An intimate ski-in, ski-out mountain retreat focused on conversation, hospitality, and shared experience.

These are examples of the kind of experiences LUCIEN is being built to create. Emerald members receive one retreat per year included, with pre-booking access before availability opens more broadly.

The Value of Membership
The value extends beyond events.

Members gain access to relationships, introductions, experiences, perspectives, and opportunity through the people they meet.

LUCIEN is designed to help members expand their world with trust, taste, and intention.

Membership Terms

Agreement

By authorizing payment, you ("Member") enter into a membership agreement with LUCIEN LLC ("LUCIEN," "we," or "us") and agree to the following terms.

Membership & Billing

Membership is billed quarterly. Your payment method on file will be charged at the rate corresponding to your selected membership tier (Sage: $550/quarter; Emerald: $2,500/quarter) at the start of each billing period. Membership continues until cancelled.

For members on an introductory authorization hold, the first charge will occur at the end of the stated introductory period. No charge is made until that date.

Cancellation

You may cancel your membership at any time by contacting the concierge. Cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing quarter. No partial-quarter refunds are issued except at LUCIEN's sole discretion.

Events & Programming

Membership grants access to LUCIEN's event calendar, directory, concierge service, and partner benefits. Events, retreats, and programming are curated by LUCIEN and subject to change, cancellation, or rescheduling without notice. Specific events are not guaranteed as a condition of membership. LUCIEN is not liable for costs incurred in connection with cancelled or rescheduled events, including travel or accommodation.

RSVP & Attendance

Event attendance requires an accepted RSVP. Capacity is limited. LUCIEN reserves the right to decline or revoke attendance at any event at its discretion. Guest policies vary per event and are set by LUCIEN.

Member Conduct

Members are expected to conduct themselves with discretion and respect. LUCIEN reserves the right to revoke membership without refund for conduct that is disruptive, disrespectful, or inconsistent with the values of the society. What happens within LUCIEN stays within LUCIEN.

Directory & Privacy

Member information shared with LUCIEN is held in confidence. Your profile may appear in the private member directory, visible only to active members. You may opt out of directory listing at any time. LUCIEN does not sell member data. See our Privacy Policy for full details.

No Guarantees

LUCIEN makes no representations or warranties regarding introductions, business outcomes, or results from membership. The society is a social and experiential membership — commercial results are incidental and not promised.

Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, LUCIEN LLC's liability to any member is limited to the amount paid in the most recent billing quarter. LUCIEN is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages of any kind.

Governing Law

These terms are governed by the laws of the State of New York. Any disputes shall be resolved through binding arbitration on an individual basis.

Changes to Terms

LUCIEN may update these terms with 30 days' written notice to active members. Continued membership after notice constitutes acceptance.
